source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In this landing, the Flatpak repackage list includes ESR 153 while the Flatpak and MSIX push lists contain only beta and release. The declared promotion and store-publication phases therefore differ. Fixed accepted source later adds ESR 153 to both push lists. Keep these configuration phases separate when describing the port; a declaration or later list does not prove that a rollout occurred. The imported release-filter implementation, generated graph, publishing workers and external stores were not executed or fully paired.
title: The ESR 153 update separates package promotion from initial store publication
